root_cause.text: Race condition in the amdxdna driver where the `rpm_on` flag, used to indicate an in-progress suspend/resume, was checked in `amdxdna_pm_resume_get()` to skip runtime resume, allowing a userspace command submission to proceed without the device being fully resumed when autosuspend was triggered.
root_cause.evidence: CVE description states: "When autosuspend is triggered, driver rpm_on flag is set... However, when a userspace application submits a command during this narrow window, amdxdna_pm_resume_get() may incorrectly skip the resume operation because the rpm_on flag is still set. This results in commands being submitted while the device has not actually resumed." The patch removes the `rpm_on` flag entirely and eliminates its checks from `amdxdna_pm_resume_get()` and `amdxdna_pm_suspend_put()`, instead introducing `aie2_pm_set_dpm()` which always explicitly resumes the device via `amdxdna_pm_resume_get()` without the race-prone conditional.

No fix is present in this commit.
